id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the select to set.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#shorthand)*

first.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for selecting the first option in a select component.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the select to set.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#shorthand)*

last.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for selecting the last option in a select component.

cycle.docs:
**boolean**: Whether or not to jump back to the first option of the select when the last option is currently selected. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#shorthand)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the select to set.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#shorthand)*

next.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for selecting the next option in a select component.

cycle.docs:
**bool**: Can be used for options `NEXT` and `PREVIOUS` to specify whether or not to wrap around the options list when respectively the last or first option in the select is currently active.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#or-templated-lambdas)*

operation.docs:
**string**: The operation to perform. One of `FIRST`, `LAST`, `PREVIOUS` or `NEXT` (case insensitive). When writing a lambda for this field, then return one of the following enum values: `SELECT_OP_FIRST`, `SELECT_OP_LAST`, `SELECT_OP_PREVIOUS` or `SELECT_OP_NEXT`.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#or-templated-lambdas)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the select to set.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#or-templated-lambdas)*

operation.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) that can be used to change the active option in a select component (first, last, previous or next), using a generic templatable action call.

cycle.docs:
**boolean**: Whether or not to jump to the last option of the select when the first option is currently selected. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#shorthand)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the select to set.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#shorthand)*

previous.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for selecting the previous option in a select component.

option.docs:
**string**: The option to set the select to.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#selectset-action)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the select to set.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#selectset-action)*

set.docs: You can also set an option for the template select from elsewhere in your YAML file with the [`select.set` Action](https://esphome.io/components/select#select-set-action).

index.docs:
**int**: The index offset of the option to be activated.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#selectset_index-action)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the select to set.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#selectset_index-action)*

set_index.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for setting the active option using its index offset.

es8388.docs:
The `es8388` select allows you to control the `dac output` and the `adc input_mic` of your [Es8388](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/es8388/).

*See also: [ES8388](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/es8388#select)*

ld2410.docs:
The `ld2410` selects allow you to configure your sensor hardware.

*See also: [LD2410 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2410#select)*

ld2412.docs:
The `ld2412` selects allow you to configure your sensor hardware.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#select)*

ld2450.docs:
The `ld2450` select allows you to control `baud rate` and `zone type` of your [Ld2450](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2450/).

*See also: [LD2450 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2450#select)*

ld6002b.docs:
The `ld6002b` select platform configures sensitivity, trigger speed, installation mode, and the active area ID.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#select)*

mitsubishi_cn105.docs:
Vane controls are optional and can be enabled independently of the climate entity's `supported_swing_modes`. They expose Mitsubishi-specific vane options that are available on the indoor unit but are not represented by Home Assistant's generic climate model. Vane controls require a top-level `mitsubishi_cn105:` hub; see [Migration From Climate-Owned Configuration](https://esphome.io/components/climate/mitsubishi_cn105#migration-from-climate-owned-configuration) if your configuration still defines the hub options on the `climate:` entry.

*See also: [Mitsubishi CN105 Climate](https://esphome.io/components/climate/mitsubishi_cn105#select)*

seeed_mr24hpc1.docs:
The `seeed_mr24hpc1` select allows you to control the configuration.

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR24HPC1 mmWave (Kit)](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr24hpc1#select)*

seeed_mr60fda2.docs:
The `seeed_mr60fda2` select allows you to control the configuration.

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR60FDA2 60GHz mmWave Fall Detection Sensor Kit](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60fda2#select)*

template.docs:
The `template` Select platform allows you to create a Select with templated values using [lambdas](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda).

*See also: [Template Select](https://esphome.io/components/select/template)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: A lambda returning a boolean value. The current selection is passed in a `StringRef` argument called `current`.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#selectis-condition)*

options.docs:
**list**: A string, or list of strings to compare with the current selection. The condition is true if any match.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#selectis-condition)*

is.docs: This [Condition](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-conditions) checks if the select is set to any one of a list of options. A lambda may also be used for more complex computations.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the select to test.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#selectis-condition)*

**string**: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#optional-variables)*

on_value.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a new value is published. See [`on_value`](https://esphome.io/components/select#select-on_value).

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#optional-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name for the select. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#optional-variables)*

icon.docs:
**icon**: Manually set the icon to use for the select in the frontend.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#optional-variables)*

internal.docs:
**boolean**: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#optional-variables)*

disabled_by_default.docs:
**boolean**: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#optional-variables)*

entity_category.docs:
**string**: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

*See also: [Select Component](https://esphome.io/components/select#optional-variables)*
